operads/infrastructure/skill_budget_cens: Full body reviewed. Static AST reads literal gate constants without execution; eval-bank index explicitly enforces executed=False. Raw LF line/byte counts and identity-keyed shrink-only ratchet detect new/growing breaches and require removal of stale baseline entries. Coverage uses static governed names even though the docstring acknowledges the live gate dynamically enumerates the garden, so scanned-by-gate output is not a live coverage receipt. Parent-directory basename keys can collapse nested duplicate skill names; baseline int conversion is permissive. No metric counts establish skill utility or semantic preservation.
